page.overview:
Who is Funato Soldier Leader?

He is the leader of a group of Funato Clan soldiers operating on Dotō Island.

He aspires to rise through the ranks of the Funato Clan, namely a leadership position in the . He is willing to reward good service, promising a gold nugget his subordinates if they were successfully carried out his orders. During his operation, he was against needlessly killing hostages, but considered it they were no longer useful. Aware of how strict Tenma Funato was, he feared reporting any failure to him, and similarly looked forward to reporting any success.

He is an adult male of average height, with olive skin and short dark hair. He has a short forked moustache and narrow irregular sideburns. He is dressed in the standard uniform of the clan members, consisting of a vest and armlets. Like many others, he displayed a traditional Funato tattoo on his head.

He commanded a large number of men in the Funato clan. Despite accurately predicting how his opponents would act, he was lulled into lowering his guard when Sarada and Mitsuki pretended to surrender, allowing her to trick him with genjutsu and knock him out. He was a capable Water Release user, creating tendrils to hold people in place and attack, as well as sending signals high in the air to his men.
